[P1] 动物爸爸
一级棒
撰文/周嘉峰 插画/蔡怡真

[P2] 动物爸爸一级棒
撰文/周嘉峰 插画/蔡怡真

浙江出版联合集团
浙江少年儿童出版社
2/11

[P3] 南极很冷很冷，住在那里的国王企鹅却是个好爸爸。当国王企鹅妈妈生下蛋后，国王企鹅爸爸会和妈妈轮流孵蛋。它们把蛋放在脚上，紧紧抱住，以保持蛋所需的温暖，这样小企鹅才能孵出来。

▼ 国王企鹅爸爸和妈妈会轮流孵蛋，但是，企鹅爸爸会比妈妈花更多的时间孵蛋。

老婆，请你帮帮忙，我吃完东西后马上回来孵蛋。

老公，你快去吃吧，孵蛋的任务先交给我。

我要好好保护蛋，让宝宝可以顺利孵出来。

国王企鹅爸爸孵蛋时，会把蛋放在双脚上，再用肚子上的羽毛盖住，使蛋保持温暖。如果蛋不小心露出来，就会冻伤；如果掉到冰冷的地面上，没多久就会结冰冻住，那就再也孵不出小企鹅了。

[P4] 勇敢的帝企鹅爸爸
除了国王企鹅，帝企鹅爸爸也很勇敢。帝企鹅妈妈会在
冬天生蛋，再把蛋交给帝企鹅爸爸照顾。帝企鹅爸爸会抱着
蛋站在寒风中，两个月不吃不喝，一直等到小企鹅孵出后，
再交给帝企鹅妈妈照顾。没有帝企鹅爸爸的保护，小企鹅就
没办法出生。
▼ 帝企鹅爸爸孵蛋的时候会聚在一起，用背部抵挡风雪。
风雪好大，真的好冷
啊！但是为了宝宝，
我们要坚持下去！
▲ 帝企鹅爸爸必须不吃不喝，独
自照顾宝宝两个月，而帝企鹅
妈妈不会帮忙孵蛋。
小企鹅出生后，帝企鹅爸爸
妈妈会轮流找食物喂养它。
宝宝，多吃一点，才会快快
长大哦！

[P5] 艾氏树蛙爸爸守护小宝宝

艾氏树蛙爸爸会在树蛙妈妈产卵之后，留下来守护卵，
让树蛙妈妈去休息。如果蜗牛、蚂蚁想吃掉蛙卵，艾氏树蛙
爸爸就会赶走它们。为了避免卵因缺水而干死，艾氏树蛙爸
爸会用身体沾水，然后爬上爬下，为每一颗卵“浇”水。

▲ 艾氏树蛙爸爸会用
身体沾水，使卵保
持湿润。

▼ 艾氏树蛙爸爸必须时刻小心，以免
自己或蛙卵被敌人吃掉。

没人保护我们
了。救命啊！

艾氏树蛙通常会选择有积水的竹筒产卵。

蜗牛走开，不准
吃我的宝宝！

[P6] 水雉爸爸独自照顾宝宝
水雉妈妈生下蛋后就离开了，孵蛋和照顾宝宝的工作全部由水雉爸爸负责。水雉爸爸独自孵蛋，等到宝宝出生后，再带着宝宝到处找食物，让宝宝吃个饱；遇到下雨，水雉爸爸还会用翅膀帮宝宝们挡雨，避免它们着凉。
▲ 水雉爸爸孵蛋时，必须忍受风雨，不能随便离开。
我是夜鹭，嘿嘿，看到美味的食物了！
▶ 宝宝孵出后，水雉爸爸还要教它们如何寻找食物。
宝宝，要认真学哦！
别怕，爸爸保护你们！
当遇到敌人或下雨时，水雉爸爸会保护宝宝不受伤害。
6/11

[P7] 海马爸爸还会生宝宝
海马爸爸也是好爸爸，生宝宝是海马爸爸的工作。它不但要吃得多，让肚子里的宝宝有足够的营养，还要随时躲避敌人，避免被吃掉，要不然小宝宝就没办法出生了。
哎哟，肚子好重，都游不快了！
←怀孕的海马爸爸，游泳的速度很慢。
咦，刚才明明看到有食物的……
▼万一遇到危险，海马爸爸会躲藏在海草里，以免被敌人发现。
哇，海马爸爸好厉害，还会生宝宝呢！
爸爸好，感谢您把我们生出来。
耶，我的宝宝们终于出生了！

[P8] 又凶猛又温柔的狮子爸爸
狮子爸爸也是好爸爸。它保卫狮群时很凶猛、很勇敢，但是陪小狮子玩的时候却很温柔，还会教小狮子捕猎的技巧。
▶ 狮子爸爸会对付
其他想要偷袭的
狮子。
吼
好凶啊，我得
赶快闪开！
▼ 当鬣狗想要攻击小狮子时，狮子爸爸
会立刻赶走鬣狗。
有我在，你们
休想吃掉我的
孩子！
爸爸救我！
啊，狮子爸爸
来了，我们赶
快逃！
▶ 狮子爸爸对小狮子非常温柔，不论小狮子怎么抓咬它，狮子爸爸都不会生气。

[P9] 我们的爸爸和动物爸爸一样棒
我们的爸爸也和动物爸爸一样，会保护并照顾孩子。爸爸担心孩子肚子饿，会做饭或买饭给他们吃。爸爸还会带孩子到处玩，教他们很多生活技能。为了让孩子学习更多的知识，很多爸爸会亲自送孩子上学。每一位爸爸都和动物爸爸一样棒！
我们的爸爸一级棒！
爸爸常常担心我们会着凉感冒，就像企鹅爸爸担心他们宝宝受冻一样。
当我们生病了，爸爸会寸步不离地照顾我们，就像艾氏树蛙爸爸照顾蛙卵一样。
下雨天忘了带伞，爸爸会来接我们，就像水雉爸爸会帮宝宝挡雨一样。
当我们遇到危险时，爸爸就会像狮子爸爸保护小狮子一样保护我们。

[P10] 我们的爸爸和动物爸爸一样棒
我们的爸爸也和动物爸爸一样，会保护并照顾孩子。爸爸担心孩子肚子饿，会做饭或买饭给他们吃。爸爸还会带孩子到处玩，教他们很多生活技能。为了让孩子学习更多的知识，很多爸爸会亲自送孩子上学。每一位爸爸都和动物爸爸一样棒！
我们的爸爸一级棒！
爸爸常常担心我们会着凉感冒，就像企鹅爸爸担心宝宝受冻一样。
当我们生病了，爸爸会寸步不离地照顾我们，就像艾氏树蛙爸爸照顾蛙卵一样。
下雨天忘了带伞，爸爸会来接我们，就像水雉爸爸会帮宝宝挡雨一样。
当我们遇到危险时，爸爸就会像狮子爸爸保护小狮子一样保护我们。
full_text_en:
[P1] Animal Dads
Are Awesome
Written by Zhou Jiafeng  Illustrated by Cai Yizhen

[P2] Animal Dads Are Awesome
Written by Zhou Jiafeng  Illustrated by Cai Yizhen

Zhejiang Publishing United Group
Zhejiang Children's Publishing House
2/11

[P3] The South Pole is very cold. The king penguins living there are great dads. After the king penguin mom lays an egg, the dad and mom take turns incubating it. They place the egg on their feet, holding it tightly to keep it warm, so the baby penguin can hatch.

▼ King penguin dads and moms take turns incubating the egg, but the dad spends more time incubating than the mom.

Wife, please help me out. I'll go eat and come back right away to incubate the egg.

Honey, go eat quickly. I'll take over the incubating duty for now.

I must protect the egg well so the baby can hatch safely.

When the king penguin dad incubates the egg, he places it on his feet and covers it with the feathers on his belly to keep it warm. If the egg is accidentally exposed, it will get frostbite; if it falls onto the icy ground, it will freeze quickly and the baby penguin will never hatch.

[P4] Brave Emperor Penguin Dad
Besides king penguins, emperor penguin dads are also very brave. Emperor penguin moms will lay eggs in winter and then hand them over to the emperor penguin dads to care for. The emperor penguin dad will hold the egg and stand in the cold wind, not eating or drinking for two months, until the baby penguin hatches, and then hand it over to the emperor penguin mom to care for. Without the protection of the emperor penguin dad, the baby penguin cannot be born.
▼ Emperor penguin dads huddle together while incubating eggs, using their backs to block the wind and snow.
It's such a big snowstorm, it's really cold!
But for the baby, we must keep going!
▲ Emperor penguin dads must not eat or drink, and take care of the baby alone for two months, while the emperor penguin mom does not help incubate the egg.
After the baby penguin is born, the emperor penguin dad and mom will take turns finding food to feed it.
Baby, eat more, so you can grow up quickly!

[P5] Dad of the Ai's Tree Frog Protects His Babies

After the female tree frog lays her eggs, the male Ai's tree frog stays behind to guard them, letting the mother rest. If snails or ants try to eat the frog eggs, the male Ai's tree frog will chase them away. To prevent the eggs from drying out, the male Ai's tree frog will soak his body in water, then climb up and down, watering each egg.

▲ The male Ai's tree frog uses his body to soak water, keeping the eggs moist.

▼ The male Ai's tree frog must be constantly careful, to avoid himself or the eggs being eaten by enemies.

No one is protecting us now. Help!

Ai's tree frogs usually choose bamboo tubes with standing water to lay their eggs.

Go away, snail! Don't eat my babies!

[P6] Waterfowl Dad Takes Care of Babies Alone
After the waterfowl mom lays her eggs, she leaves. The job of incubating and caring for the babies falls entirely to the waterfowl dad. He incubates the eggs alone. After the babies hatch, he takes them everywhere to find food, making sure they eat their fill. When it rains, the waterfowl dad uses his wings to shield his babies from the rain, preventing them from getting cold.
▲ The waterfowl dad must endure wind and rain while incubating the eggs and cannot leave easily.
I'm a night heron, hehe, I've spotted delicious food!
▶ After the babies hatch, the waterfowl dad still teaches them how to find food.
Babies, pay close attention and learn!
Don't be afraid, Dad will protect you!
When enemies appear or it rains, the waterfowl dad protects his babies from harm.
6/11

[P7] Daddy Seahorse Can Give Birth Too
Daddy seahorse is also a great dad. Giving birth is the daddy seahorse's job. He not only has to eat a lot to give enough nutrition to the babies in his belly, but also has to constantly avoid enemies to prevent being eaten, or the little babies won't be able to be born.
"Oh, my belly is so heavy, I can't swim fast!"
← The pregnant daddy seahorse swims very slowly.
"Huh, I clearly saw food just now..."
▼ If danger comes, the daddy seahorse will hide in the seaweed to avoid being discovered by enemies.
"Wow, Daddy seahorse is so amazing, he can give birth too!"
"Daddy, thank you for giving birth to us."
"Yay, my babies have finally been born!"

[P8] Fierce and Gentle Lion Dad
Lion dads are also great dads. They are fierce and brave when protecting the pride, but gentle when playing with cubs, and even teach them hunting skills.
▶ Lion dads will deal with
other lions who want to
attack.
Roar
Oh, so fierce! I'd better
run away quickly!
▼ When hyenas try to attack cubs, lion dads
will immediately chase them away.
I'm here! You
won't eat my
child!
Dad, save me!
Oh, the lion dad
is here! Let's
run away quickly!
▶ Lion dads are very gentle with cubs. No matter how the cubs scratch or bite, the lion dad won't get angry.

[P9] Our Dads Are as Great as Animal Dads
Our dads are just like animal dads—they protect and take care of their children. Dads worry if their kids are hungry, so they cook or buy food for them. Dads also take their kids out to play and teach them many life skills. To help their kids learn more, many dads personally send them to school. Every dad is as great as an animal dad!
Our dad is awesome!
Dads often worry that we might catch a cold, just like penguin dads worry about their babies getting cold.
When we are sick, dads take care of us without leaving our side, just like the male tree frog takes care of his frog eggs.
When it rains and we forget our umbrella, dad will come to pick us up, just like the male water chicken shelters his babies from the rain.
When we are in danger, dad will protect us just like a lion dad protects his lion cubs.

[P10] Our Dads Are as Great as Animal Dads
Our dads are just like animal dads, protecting and taking care of their children. Dads worry if their kids are hungry, so they cook or buy food for them. Dads also take their kids out to play and teach them many life skills. To help their kids learn more, many dads personally send them to school. Every dad is as great as an animal dad!
Our dad is awesome!
Dads often worry that we might catch a cold, just like penguin dads worry about their babies getting cold.
When we are sick, dads take care of us without leaving our side, just like the male tree frog takes care of the frog eggs.
When it rains and we forget our umbrella, dad will come to pick us up, just like the male water chicken shelters its babies from the rain.
When we are in danger, dad will protect us just like a lion dad protects his baby lion.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本封面，展示了一只企鹅爸爸用脚孵蛋的画面，标题为《动物爸爸一级棒》，并标注了撰文和插画作者。
[P2] 本页为绘本的扉页，显示书名《动物爸爸一级棒》、作者和插画师信息，以及出版社信息，画面中央有一只海马在水草中游动。
[P3] 本页介绍了国王企鹅爸爸在南极寒冷环境中孵蛋的场景，通过文字和插图展示了企鹅父母轮流孵蛋，尤其是爸爸承担更多孵蛋责任，并强调了保护蛋的重要性。
[P4] 本页介绍了帝企鹅爸爸在严寒中孵蛋的勇敢行为，以及小企鹅出生后父母轮流喂养的情景。左侧插图展示了帝企鹅爸爸们抱团御寒，右侧照片展示了帝企鹅爸爸喂养小企鹅的温馨画面。
[P5] 本页介绍了艾氏树蛙爸爸在产卵后守护蛙卵的行为，包括驱赶天敌、用身体沾水为卵保湿，并通过插图和对话展示了其守护过程中的警惕与勇敢。
[P6] 本页介绍了水雉爸爸独自承担孵蛋和照顾宝宝的全部责任，包括在风雨中孵蛋、带宝宝觅食、用翅膀为宝宝挡雨，并在遇到危险时保护它们。
[P7] 本页介绍了海马爸爸怀孕并生育宝宝的过程，描述了他为宝宝获取营养、躲避天敌的辛苦，以及宝宝出生后与爸爸的温馨互动。
[P8] 本页介绍了狮子爸爸既凶猛又温柔的双重性格，通过文字和插图展示了它在保卫狮群时的勇敢，以及在陪伴小狮子时的温柔和耐心，包括驱赶鬣狗、教小狮子捕猎等行为。
[P9] 本页通过对比人类爸爸与多种动物爸爸（如企鹅、树蛙、水雉、狮子）的育儿行为，强调了爸爸在保护、照顾、教育孩子方面的共同点和伟大之处，鼓励孩子认识到爸爸的付出与爱。
[P10] 本页通过对比人类爸爸与企鹅、树蛙、水雉、狮子等动物爸爸的育儿行为，强调了爸爸在保护、照顾、教育孩子方面的共同点和伟大之处，鼓励孩子认识到爸爸的付出与爱。
[P11] 画面展示了一只黄色的海马爸爸在海草丛中，周围有许多刚出生的小海马在游动，表现了海马爸爸生育后与宝宝们在一起的温馨场景。
